description: The result of one Tropis analysis pass over one node.

agentVersion.description: The Tropis build that produced this verdict.

backend.description: Which model produced this verdict, and under which prompt version.

effort.description: Reasoning effort level requested from the provider, when one was set. Empty means the provider's default.

promptVersion.description: Version of the prompt template used. Results are only comparable within a prompt version.

think.description: Thinking setting sent to a local model (true, false or a level), when one was set. Empty means the model's default.

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence in this verdict, from 0 to 1. Report genuine uncertainty rather than anchoring high.

evidence.description: The specific observations this verdict relied on. Required and non-empty, including for 'insufficient_evidence', where what was examined and found wanting is the evidence.

collectedAt.description: When this specific observation was taken (RFC 3339).

excerpt.description: The specific line or value relied upon. Quote it rather than paraphrasing.

ref.description: Where the observation sits within its source: a SMART attribute name, an event UID, a log offset.

source.description: The collector that produced this observation, for example 'smartctl', 'kubelet-events' or 'pod-logs'.

inputDigest.description: Hash of the exact analysis input, tying this verdict to the bytes that produced it.

nextStep.description: Advisory text for a human operator. Phrase as a recommendation, never as an instruction to act: Tropis is read-only and takes no action.

node.description: The Kubernetes node name this verdict concerns.

observedAt.description: When the underlying signals were collected (RFC 3339).

relationship.description: Whether the host-layer evidence explains the Kubernetes-layer symptoms. Use 'coincidental' when both a host anomaly and a workload problem are present but unrelated, and 'insufficient_evidence' when the evidence does not support a judgement either way. Both are expected answers, not failures.

rootCause.description: The confirmed fault. Set this only when relationship is 'causal'; omit it entirely otherwise.

layer.description: Which layer the fault originates in.

triggeredBy.description: Pre-filter rule IDs that raised this node as a candidate.

title: Verdict
